stories.headline: Airframe Ultra schedules its PC combat-racing launch for November 5
stories.summary: Videocult and Akupara Games have scheduled [Airframe Ultra](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522120/Airframe_Ultra/) for November 5 on PC. The fast-paced hoverbike combat racer combines online multiplayer with local split-screen racing, customizable bikes and a reputation-based progression system. Steam still lists the game as upcoming this morning, so release availability is not yet confirmed.

stories.headline: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra launches November 13; ExileCon reveal is November 6
stories.summary: Grinding Gear Games has announced [Covens of Umbra](https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/4012420), the next free expansion for the original Path of Exile. Its PC launch is scheduled for November 13 in the Pacific time zone; further details are due in an ExileCon broadcast on November 6 at 12:30 p.m. PST. [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/238960/Path_of_Exile/) also carries the base game.

stories.headline: GOG hosts its first games showcase on November 5
stories.summary: PC storefront [GOG](https://www.gog.com/) premieres its first dedicated showcase today, November 5, at 18:00 UTC (19:00 CET) on its official YouTube channel as part of its 18th anniversary. The presentation promises new DRM-free game additions, storefront features and further game-preservation efforts. Specific game reveals have not yet been announced ahead of the broadcast.

stories.headline: Wielders of the Essence is scheduled to release on Steam November 5
stories.summary: Lavapotion's [Wielders of the Essence](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3546610/Wielders_of_the_Essence/) is due on PC November 5. The single-player bullet-heaven game mixes short horde-survival runs with persistent town-building upgrades, spells and commandable troops. Its Steam release is still marked as upcoming this morning, with a demo available.

stories.headline: Where the Seeds Fall releases on Steam with World Tree parkour adventure
stories.summary: Cygames released [Where the Seeds Fall](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4139580/Where_the_Seeds_Fall/) on PC on November 4. Developed by CygamesEdge and ZEREO, the single-player 3D action-adventure centers on climbing and traversing the World Tree while escorting a mysterious child. The Steam store now lists the game as released.

stories.headline: Valve warns Steam release reviews can now take up to 12 business days
stories.summary: Valve says a significant rise in Steam store and game submissions has stretched some pre-release reviews to as long as 12 business days, compared with its usual three to five. New developer checklist requirements include launching a build through Steam for at least five minutes and checking prerequisites and achievements. The review delays may affect PC release schedules; Valve has not attributed the surge to AI-generated games.

stories.headline: Nexus Mods introduces mandatory AI-content disclosures for mod uploads
stories.summary: [Nexus Mods](https://help.nexusmods.com/article/180-ai-policy-changes-2026) is introducing distinct AI-generated, AI-assisted and AI-media disclosure labels, alongside permissions for how creators' work may be reused. New uploads must use the updated fields immediately; existing mods have a 60-day transition period from November 3, 2026 to January 2, 2027. The platform is not banning AI-generated mods.

stories.headline: Fortnite Crew ends monthly outfits and OG Pass as V-Bucks rewards increase
stories.summary: Epic Games says [Fortnite Crew](https://www.fortnite.com/news/big-changes-to-fortnite-crew-launching-december-5) will change on December 5. December is the final exclusive Crew Pack outfit, while the OG Pass ends; monthly V-Bucks rise from 800 to 1,000–1,600 based on subscription tenure. Members gain 20% extra Fortnite XP and non-member squadmates gain 10%. The US subscription price remains $11.99 per month and the Battle, Music, LEGO and Rocket Pass Premium benefits remain included. Fortnite has no official Steam page; visit the [official Fortnite site](https://www.fortnite.com/) instead.

stories.headline: Pillars of Eternity and Deadfire open full controller-support betas on PC
stories.summary: Obsidian's November 4 public tests bring native gamepad support to both [Pillars of Eternity](https://store.steampowered.com/app/291650/Pillars_of_Eternity/) and [Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire](https://store.steampowered.com/app/560130/Pillars_of_Eternity_II_Deadfire/) on Steam, GOG and Xbox on PC. Both RPGs can be played with a controller from character creation through the end, in real-time-with-pause or turn-based mode, including Deadfire's ship combat. Deadfire's beta also revises turn-based initiative and action costs. On Steam, owners can opt into `public_beta` through each game's Betas settings; Obsidian warns the test builds may contain bugs.
